summary: Bonsai 2 27B is a 27‑billion‑parameter transformer model that uses aggressive quantization to shrink its footprint by roughly nine times. It can be run via HuggingFace Transformers, ONNX Runtime, or TorchScript, requiring no API key. Researchers and developers needing high‑capacity models on limited GPU memory (e.g., 16 GB) will find it useful. It offers a modest speed advantage (15% faster than Llama2 13B) but suffers from installation failures and limited documentation.
